items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I'm sure you knew his successor, Cootie Williams.

ctx.x: '32 and I wasn't acquainted with his work too much. I liked it, what he did; I liked him with Duke Ellington. And the different various recordings that he was on.
I'm sure you knew his successor, Cootie Williams.
Oh yes, oh yes. Another name that brought back very fond memories was Fulbright.
